args.title: Bellwether Office Newsletter Summary - Retail Returns Logistics
args.body:
- Apparel return rates have climbed to 24%, making returns a major cost driver for retailers.
- Consolidating return processing into dedicated hubs cut handling costs by roughly 20% (a fifth).
- Companion piece (subscriber content): reselling returned items within 10 days preserves most of the original margin, highlighting speed-to-resale as a key profitability lever.
